entities.name: Septar Mehmet Yakub
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Septar Mehmet Yakub (1904–1991) was a Crimean Tatar lawyer, thinker, spiritual leader of Tatars and Turks in Dobruja, Mufti of the Muslim community in Romania. He was a promoter of harmony and peace.
